items.text: Elon Musk’s xAI resolves claims against Apple over AI competition
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk旗下xAI与Apple就AI竞争诉讼达成和解，移除苹果AI垄断不确定性风险。

items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk的X Corp与xAI针对Apple的反垄断诉讼已解决，消除了Apple一项诉讼尾部风险。

items.text: Musk urges top AI labs, Chinese companies to test each other's models amid calls for slowdown
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk呼吁顶级AI实验室与中国公司互相测试模型，AI监管/竞争格局变动或利好中国大模型相关港股。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX or Tesla: Which Elon Musk Stock Should Investors Buy?
items.summary_cn: 据报道，媒体讨论投资者应买Tesla还是SpaceX，反映两者关系与估值预期，间接关联kcn的SPCX/SPCH持仓。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk, the world’s richest man, says he’s living in an Airstream trailer to oversee xAI’s biggest expansion yet
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk住Airstream房车亲督xAI最大规模扩建，暗示xAI算力/数据中心扩张提速，间接利好SpaceX等算力链。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's Latest Updates On Tesla-SpaceX Merger, Terafab Factory
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk谈及Tesla-SpaceX合并及Terafab工厂进展，传闻级信息但未上市公司不计入tickers。

items.author: Burry
items.text: ‘Big Short’ trader Michael Burry slams OpenAI, Anthropic for ‘self-serving’ calls to slow AI – joining backlash
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Burry公开抨击OpenAI/Anthropic呼吁'放缓AI'是'自私'之举，加入反AI监管阵营。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The AI Hoax being perpetrated by the Radical Left Dumocrats is reminiscent of their Global Warming Scam of not so long ago, where everyone was going to die from extreme heat. What happened? MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN!!! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump发帖称AI是'骗局'，将AI类比此前全球变暖骗局，是其反AI叙事的延续，可能影响AI板块情绪。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The claim that “AI is going to take over the World” is a Hoax, just like Global “Warming,” where everyone was going to be dead by now, RUSSIA, RUSSIA, RUSSIA, UKRAINE, UKRAINE, UKRAINE, or Impeachment Hoax #1, or Impeachment Hoax #2. These are all Radical Left Dumocrats, who never give up, but seldom win. Hopefully, the Voters have seen the light! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump再次称'AI将接管世界'是骗局，叠加其一贯反AI立场，对AI板块情绪偏负面。

items.author: Trump
items.text: I am the Hoax Buster, and I’m right now breaking another Hoax — That AI is going to take over, consume, and destroy the World, and that Robots will be marching into our Cities, and getting rid of us all! This is even wilder than the RUSSIA, RUSSIA, RUSSIA HOAX, or the Global Warming Scam. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump称自己是'骗局终结者'，抨击AI接管世界与机器人威胁论，持续唱空AI叙事。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: Trump Has Made More Trades Than All of Congress Combined
items.summary_cn: 据报道，媒体对比Trump个人交易频次与全体国会议员，间接提示其持仓/交易公开记录的政治影响力。
